label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is the user-controlled parameter NAME (from request.getParameterNames()) written directly to HTML response via toCharArray() without sanitization. The parameter name comes from attacker-controllable HTTP request parameters and flows through doSomething() unchanged to the response writer. No HTML encoding is applied before writing to response.

evidence.note: User iterates over parameter names and selects one based on value presence
doSomething passes param (parameter name) to bar without modification
bar.toCharArray() written directly to response writer without HTML encoding
